items.summary: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

items.title: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
items.summary: Just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, Google DeepMind is releasing Gemini 4 Carbon, which tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with 59 points. Google says the model is built for extended agent workflows and the full cyber defense lifecycle. Because of those advanced security capabilities, access is limited to selected security experts at first....

items.title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra tops Retell’s voice agent benchmark, while Codex helps it reach a $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee.

items.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
items.summary: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

items.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
items.summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

items.title: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing With Cached Playwright Replays
items.summary: QA Agent is a new source-available Playwright library for agentic browser regression testing. The agent associates test instructions expressed in natural language to actions on the user interface, caches those when appropriate for faster CI replays, remapping them to test specifications when the user interface changes. Verification is based on multi-model consensus and vision model evaluations. By Bruno Couriol

items.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
items.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow and ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
items.summary: Tin AI từ Google DeepMind về "Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model". Mở bài gốc để đọc chi tiết và đánh giá tác động với team.

items.title: Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs
items.summary: Google is opening up Android Studio to third-party AI agents. Through a new "Bring Your Own Agent" feature, the IDE now supports more than 40 coding agents, including Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex. Google says new terminal tools also help agents finish UI tasks 77 percent faster while using up to three times fewer tokens. Android development is becoming agent-centric too....

items.title: OpenAI teases Dots for Europe, but its Berlin DevDay was really about building a platform
items.summary: At DevDay Exchange in Berlin, OpenAI mostly repeated what it had already announced, but it did share a few new details. The AI assistant Dots should roll out more widely in Europe "in a few weeks," and weekly Codex users in Germany have grown twentyfold since January....

items.title: OpenAI doubles usage limits on Pro plans as competition with Anthropic heats up
items.summary: OpenAI is doubling usage limits across its paid plans, from Pro 100 to Pro 500. A planned cut to the Pro 200 quota was reversed after user pushback. More efficient models like Terra and Sol should push usable capacity even higher. The move comes just ahead of Anthropic's IPO, as both companies fight for B2B dominance in AI....
